tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation, which triggers scoped abstention. No additional measurements or model fit are warranted.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At the shared horizon H = 0.6, this model predicts a single value of y/u_now, but the observed ratios include both positive and negative values.
The pilot signature indicates nonstationary oscillation, not merely insufficient data to estimate stationary memory parameters.
The pilot already samples the target horizon; a slow-reversal test does not address the observed high-frequency signature.
This probe distinguishes stationary branch mechanisms, not the observed nonstationary oscillation.
